_comment: Copy to <org root>/.agent-mail/roster.json and fill in. This file is the
single source of identity for the whole network: the dashboard reads the
human's name, the site, the seats and the projects from here and hardcodes
none of them. Absolute paths only — a relative 'home' silently produces a
seat that never matches its own process.
Delete this _comment key; JSON has no comments and every reader ignores it,
but it will show up in your dashboard's raw view.

overseer-SITE.description: supervising agent — user-facing, permission-prompted, owns no repo
